findings.issue: README says `make test` runs 14 tests; the suite actually has 22, all passing.
findings.why_it_matters: Minor documentation drift. It does not affect the methodology.

findings.issue: The Makefile calls bare `python`. The CLAUDE.md gotcha says this can resolve to conda, whose scikit-learn changes the hgb row (test R^2 -0.48 vs the pinned -0.50). I ran `make test` with .venv first on PATH, but I did not rerun `make all` to regenerate metrics.
findings.why_it_matters: The numbers depend on which interpreter runs the pipeline. The README does not say to activate the venv before `make all`.

findings.issue: Seeds are fixed for hgb (random_state=0). Ridge, StandardScaler and DummyRegressor are deterministic. The mean baseline uses the 2011 training mean and the persistence baseline uses cnt_lag_1.
findings.why_it_matters: No problem found. Baselines are reported next to every model on both valid and test.

findings.issue: Passing `--final` scores the test split with the --target runs. The code does not stop it from being used more than once or after tuning, so the one-look rule is enforced only by convention. The git log shows one test look.
findings.why_it_matters: Weak test-set discipline, but no violation found.
